title: Signature Reference-First Rule
description: A Signature-original rule for genome work: always align to the public reference assembly (never to a private sample), cite the accession, and state the assembly version in every analysis. The rule keeps all downstream work reproducible and keeps private data out of the pipeline entirely. Signature-original.

print('rule: align to public reference; cite accession + assembly version')
print('private data never enters the pipeline')

title: Signature GC Calculator
description: A Signature-original teaching tool: compute GC content from any sequence string, the first statistic every genome student learns. The calculator's exercise runs it over the coded teaching models to show how GC% summarizes a genome in one number. Signature-original.

title: Signature K-mer Profiler
description: A Signature-original profiler: count k-mers (short substrings) in a sequence to build a composition fingerprint — the technique behind fast taxonomic classifiers. The profiler runs on teaching models to demonstrate the method without touching real data. Signature-original.
demo:
from collections import Counter
s = 'ATGCGCATGCGC'
print('3-mer profile:', dict(Counter(s[i:i+3] for i in range(len(s)-2))))
print('k-mer fingerprints power fast taxonomic classifiers')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Organelle Primer
